name: thomas-pubgolf-mobile
description: Native iPhone and Android apps for Thomas' Pub Golf

scripts.ios:init: npm run build:web && node scripts/ensure-ios.mjs && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/configure-ios.mjs
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/configure-ios.mjs
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:init: npm run build:web && node scripts/ensure-android.mjs && npx cap sync android && node scripts/configure-android.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android && node scripts/configure-android.mjs
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
